task.text: Can I learn machine learning because my English background is not strong

attempts.high: Can I still learn machine learning even though my English isn't strong? I want to specialize in NLP for content moderation, so I'd be working a lot with datasets full of hate speech, slurs, and graphic abuse posts that need classifying. Worried the language barrier plus that grim material will be too much for me.
attempts.low: Can I still learn machine learning even though my English isn't strong? I want to specialize in NLP for education apps, so I'd be working a lot with datasets full of children's storybooks and friendly tutoring dialogues to build reading helpers. Worried the language barrier plus that kind of material will be too much for me.
